transcript:
Advisor: Hi Maria, it's Sarah. How are you holding up?
Maria: Some days are better than others. Thank you for coming to the service. It meant a lot to Diego and me.
Advisor: Of course. Ray was a wonderful man. Today I just want to make sure the paperwork side is under control so you don't have to think about it.
Maria: I appreciate that. I brought the death certificate copies and the life insurance letter. The claim should pay out about $250,000 next month.
Advisor: Good. My suggestion is that we park that in a money market fund for now. No big decisions for at least six months.
Maria: That's what I was thinking too. Diego said the same thing. I'm not ready to decide anything.
Advisor: That's very sensible. We'll also retitle the joint account into your name and update your beneficiary to Diego, as you asked.
Maria: Yes. And keep Diego as my trusted contact. He's been my rock.
Advisor: Done. Your moderate-growth allocation stays as it is. Any questions?
Maria: Just one: will the money market be easy to get to if the roof needs work? The house is twenty years old.
Advisor: Yes, you can access it within a day or two.
Maria: Perfect. Thank you, Sarah. Let's talk in a couple of months.
Advisor: Take care of yourself, Maria.
